item.title: Capturing and Cracking a WPA Handshake
item.description: In this blog, I walk through how I captured a WPA 4-Way Handshake from a nearby access point and cracked the password offline, using a wireless adapter in monitor mode, a deauthentication attack, and a custom wordlist built from a vendor's default password pattern.

item.title: Every Call Leaves a Trail - Extracting IP Addresses and Locations from WhatsApp Calls
item.description: How the STUN protocol and WebRTC expose a caller's real IP address during WhatsApp calls, and how a tool can capture STUN packets to extract and geolocate the other participant's IP in real time.

item.title: Getting Remote Root Shell on Devices via Portainer
item.description: In this blog, we explore how to gain remote root access on devices via Portainer, covering OSINT techniques, brute-force attacks, and exploiting misconfigurations, while offering mitigation strategies to enhance security.

item.title: Compromising CCTVs 101
item.description: How attackers can gain access to CCTV devices via the RTSP protocol, using tools like Shodan, Google Dorking, and port scanning.

item.title: Password Cracking
item.description: This blog dives into password cracking techniques like brute force and dictionary attacks, highlighting how attackers exploit weak passwords and the importance of strong security measures
